items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A decision the user must make before going on, on Base UI's AlertDialog: Dialog's scrim and popup with role="alertdialog", no close button and no dismissal by an outside click, a Cancel and an Action in the footer.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An action button: primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants in three density-aware sizes, with disabled and loading states.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid to pick one day, several days or a range, on react-day-picker with date-fns, styled with token roles: control-sized day buttons, the accent solid for the chosen day and the accent subtle band for a range.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox on Base UI's Checkbox, ticked, unticked or mixed, in three sizes, with CheckboxGroup for several checkboxes sharing one value and a parent "select all".

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: One choice from a long list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox: an input in an Input-like frame with clear and open buttons, and a popup of filtered items, groups, a no-results line and a status line, in three sizes.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: A date or a range of dates, typed into a text field (read with date-fns in a format, yyyy-MM-dd by default) or picked from a Calendar in a popup, on InputGroup and Base UI's Popover, in three sizes.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog on Base UI's Dialog: a trigger, a scrim, a centred popup in four widths with a title, a description, a scrolling body, a footer of actions and a close button.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A form field on Base UI's Field parts: label, control, description and error tied together, with invalid, touched, dirty and disabled state taken from TanStack Form or set by hand.

items.name: file-input
items.title: FileInput
items.description: A file picker on a native <input type="file"> (Base UI's Input), as one line like an Input or as a dashed dropzone, with a Clear button and accept filtering of dropped files.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A <form> laid out as a column of Fields and submitted through TanStack Form: no native validation, handleSubmit on submit, focus on the first invalid field.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: A square, icon-only action button with Button's four variants in three density-aware sizes, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text input in three density-aware sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.

items.name: number-input
items.title: NumberInput
items.description: A number input on Base UI's NumberField with decrement and increment buttons, bounds, steps, locale formatting, and three density-aware sizes.

items.name: password-input
items.title: PasswordInput
items.description: A password input with a show/hide button, on InputGroup and Base UI's Input, in three density-aware sizes.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small non-modal panel attached to a control, on Base UI's Popover: a trigger, and a popup on color.bg.overlay with an optional title, description, controls and a close action, placed on any side of the trigger.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: One choice out of several, on Base UI's RadioGroup and Radio: a fieldset of radios named by a FieldLegend, each option in a FieldItem with its own label and description, in three sizes.

items.name: search-input
items.title: SearchInput
items.description: A search box on InputGroup and Base UI's Input: a search icon, type="search", and a Clear button (and Escape) while there is text, in three density-aware sizes.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One choice from a list, on Base UI's Select: a trigger that looks like an Input and shows the chosen label, and a listbox popup with items, groups and separators, in three sizes.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the window over a scrim, on Base UI's Dialog: right, left, top or bottom, three widths, a header, a scrolling body, a pinned footer and a close button.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider on Base UI's Slider: one value or a range with two thumbs, horizontal or vertical, on a size.track track with an accent indicator, in three thumb sizes.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off switch on Base UI's Switch: a track that fills with the accent solid and a sliding thumb, in three sizes.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input on Base UI's Input rendering a <textarea>, in Input's three sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Field.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: A time of day typed into hour, minute, optional second and AM/PM segments, on Base UI's Input: the arrow keys step a segment and digits fill it, in three sizes.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: ToggleButton
items.description: A button that stays pressed or unpressed, on Base UI's Toggle, in a ghost or outline variant and three density-aware sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: Toggle buttons with one shared value, on Base UI's ToggleGroup: a segmented outline track or quiet ghost items, single or multiple selection, horizontal or vertical, in three density-aware sizes.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for a control, shown on hover and keyboard focus, on Base UI's Tooltip: a neutral-solid bubble at z.tooltip on any side of the trigger, with an optional keyboard shortcut.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Class-name merging that knows the Tailwind names of the Byterygon token roles. Every Byterygon component imports it from @/lib/cn.

items.name: theme-scope
items.title: theme-scope
items.description: Gives a popup in a portal the data-theme and data-density of the control that opened it, and reads length tokens in px. Select, Combobox and MultiSelect import it from @/lib/theme-scope.

items.name: theme-default
items.title: Byterygon theme: default
items.description: The Byterygon default theme: a blue-teal brand on a neutral tinted with the same hue, light by default, comfortable density, WCAG 2.2 AA. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-high-contrast
items.title: Byterygon theme: high-contrast
items.description: High contrast: WCAG 2.2 AAA (7:1 text, 4.5:1 for controls and focus), pure grey neutral, a deep blue accent and a thick focus ring. Comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-midnight
items.title: Byterygon theme: midnight
items.description: Midnight: dark first, on a deep blue neutral with a periwinkle accent. The light scheme is a cool blue-tinted counterpart. Comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-paper
items.title: Byterygon theme: paper
items.description: Paper: a warm light theme for reading. Cream backgrounds, a rust accent, larger text with relaxed line height, rounder corners, comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-slate
items.title: Byterygon theme: slate
items.description: Slate: near-greyscale and minimal. A muted slate-blue accent on a barely tinted neutral, square-ish corners, light by default, comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-terminal
items.title: Byterygon theme: terminal
items.description: Terminal: dark first, a green accent on a green-black neutral, monospace for all interface text, 13 px text, square corners, compact density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.
